verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line on Glama's pricing page saying workflows can be automated with schedules or webhooks. That suggests some webhook-triggered automation, but nothing shows the agent subscribing to events from connected downstream apps or connectors. missing for 10: documentation of event subscriptions or triggers tied to connected downstream apps and connectors, webhook registration and payload details, event types per connector, delivery guarantees, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe my agent to events from connected downstream apps (triggers/webhooks) instead of polling them

citations.quote: Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
